announcements.title: Update Information for Guest Lecture
announcements.text:
Hi Students,
Starting next week, the guest lectures will be held at 10:00 a.m. in the same place (CMC M3017). All students are required to attend and are encouraged to participate actively. Participation will be recorded as extra credit. The guest lecture slides are expected to be uploaded to Canvas within one day after each lecture. For more information about the guest lectures, please refer to the previous announcement.
After each guest lecture, you are required to complete a one-page reflection and submit it via Canvas within two weeks of the lecture.
In addition, the group formation process has been finalized. You may now begin working on your group project. The deadline for the group project is November 28, 2026. Please refer to the previous announcement for detailed requirements.
Thank you for your cooperation.
IS5542 Teaching Team

announcements.title: Next Guest Lecture will start at 9:00 a.m.
announcements.text:
Hi Students, 
We will still have a guest lecture this Saturday. Please note that the lecture will start at 9:00 a.m. this week, while the venue will remain unchanged. 
Another thing: please submit the reflection after each guest lecture on time (within 2 weeks) to avoid a 20% late-submission penalty.
Best always, 
IS5542 Teaching Team
